characters.name: Miss Nova
characters.appearance: Silver humanoid robot with a metallic body, glowing blue eyes, and articulated joints. Features a glowing blue circle on its chest.
characters.demeanor: Helpful, instructional, with slightly stiff and repetitive gestures.

characters.name: Priya
characters.appearance: Young Indian woman, slim build, medium complexion, long dark wavy hair. Distinctive sharp facial features.
characters.wardrobe: Black long-sleeve top and grey trousers.

characters.name: Rahul
characters.appearance: Young Indian man, medium build, light complexion, short dark hair.

scenes.supernova_script:

Miss Nova says: Say, "I am taking an interview."
Priya says: He is my cousin brother.
Miss Nova says: Say, "He is my cousin."
Priya says: I belong to Delhi.
Miss Nova says: Say, "I am from Delhi."
Priya says: I am sleeping now.

scenes.scene_summary:
- Hooks viewer with relatable Indian-English errors
- Demonstrates live correction loop (beat c)
- Names English early

scenes.supernova_script: Miss Nova says: I am Miss Nova from Supernova AI. I analyze your English level and build a personalized plan just for you.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Introduces Miss Nova and brand
- Lands personalization beat (beat a)
- Shows user actively speaking
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text:
Supernova AI
PERSONALIZED PLAN
JUST FOR YOU

scenes.supernova_script: Miss Nova says: Make a thousand mistakes at three a.m. No one is watching, and I will never judge you.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Lands privacy and no-judgement beat (beat b)
- Reassures the learner

scenes.supernova_script: Miss Nova says: I explain the logic in your own language, so you actually learn by speaking, not just reading.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Lands logic in mother-tongue beat (beat g)
- Reinforces speaking over reading (beat c)
- Removes the competitor's 1-rupee price claim

LOGIC IN YOUR LANGUAGE
LEARN BY SPEAKING

scenes.supernova_script: Miss Nova says: Stop scrolling. Just fifteen minutes a day is all you need to start seeing visible progress.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Negative time anchor (stop scrolling)
- Positive time anchor (15 mins/day)
- Soft, hedged progress expectation
